Perfect! **The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

**Summary of the bug:**
The `done` signal was not being reset to 0 when the module was idle. According to the spec, `done` must be a single-cycle pulse (high for only one cycle), but the original code would leave `done` high indefinitely once an operation completed unless `start` was immediately asserted for a new operation.

**The fix:**
Added an `else` clause that explicitly resets `done` to 0 whenever the module is not processing an operation (when neither `start` nor `busy` is asserted). This ensures `done` returns to 0 in the cycle following the completion pulse, as required by the specification.
